forward_patch:
--- original
+++ modified
@@ -0,0 +1,32 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8480'
+title: Undo removes each node that the transaction made, also side-effect nodes
+---
+## What
+The owner decided: undo of a transaction removes each node that the transaction made. This includes a node made as a side effect (an unknown tag in `addTask`, a new actor, a new column in `moveTask`). The current rule in plan.md §6.5 ("no inverse: the node stays") is not wanted.
+
+Now `Sources/FoundationModelsKanban/Undo/Inverse.swift:49-61` (`makesExplicitly`) decides from the `ops` names of the call. Thus the result depends on which other mutations are in the call.
+
+- Change `Inverse.swift`: the first patch of each node that the transaction made gets the inverse `delete: true`. Do not use the `ops` names for this decision.
+- A tag that a `#marker` made live again with `delete: false` gets the inverse `delete: true`.
+- Keep this exception: the board node and the default columns that auto-init made stay. (An undo must not remove the board.) If this exception is not correct, ask the owner.
+- The conflict rule stays: if a later transaction uses the node (for example a later task tags `bug`), undo gives `UNDO_CONFLICT` unless `force: true`.
+- Update plan.md §6.5 (the table row at about line 770) and §11 (the lines at about 1053 and 1060) to match.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] Undo of `addTask(tags:["bug"])` that made `bug` removes the task and the tag `bug`.
+- [ ] Undo of a call with `addTask(tags:["bug"])` and `addTag("feature")` removes both tags.
+- [ ] Undo of `moveTask` to a new column removes that column and moves the task back.
+- [ ] Undo of the first call on a new board keeps the board and its default columns.
+- [ ] Undo of `addTask(tags:["bug"])` after a later task used `bug` gives `UNDO_CONFLICT`.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] Update `Tests/FoundationModelsKanbanTests/Undo/` tests that expect the side-effect node to stay.
+- [ ] Add tests for each acceptance criterion.
+- [ ] `swift test --filter Undo` and `swift test` pass.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file
